name: Clans / Guilds
tagline: Structured cooperative groups with internal roles, shared goals, contribution tracking, and collective rewards.
desc: Clans and guilds go beyond communities by adding structure: internal roles, contribution tracking, shared objectives, and collective rewards depending on group performance. FC Mobile's league system shows individual rewards and global leaderboard simultaneously, creating dual motivation.
principle: Structure converts passive membership into active participation. The role, the contribution tracker, and the shared goal create daily reasons to engage that communities alone cannot.
warn: Guild mechanics require balancing individual and collective incentives. If individual contribution goes unrecognised, free-riding emerges.
lifecycle: Mid-to-late lifecycle. Guild systems land best once the user is invested enough to care about collective standing.
